resources.string: This template has no steps that run on this weekday.
Paste in the routine you already have and this will run it. Importing arrives in the next milestone.

resources.string: A step set to alarm will take over the screen, ring and get louder until you deal with it.
Alarms arrive at the right minute with sound, but cannot take over the screen. Enough for a reminder, easy to sleep through.
Alarms arrive on time but will not take over the screen.
Android is batching this app\'s alarms, so a step due at 06:30 may arrive at 06:45 or later. The app will not pretend otherwise.
Alarms may arrive several minutes late.
Notifications are off, so the routine only exists while this app is open. Nothing will be delivered.
Nothing will reach you outside this app.
Without them nothing can be delivered at all.
Turn the Alarms channel back up
It is set to silent, so alarms arrive without a sound.
Without it Android decides when to deliver, which can be fifteen minutes late.
Alarms will still ring, but will not wake the screen.
Your phone may stop this app overnight, whatever else is allowed.

Your phone keeps its own list of apps allowed to start on their own. This app cannot see that list, so it cannot tell you whether this is already done. If alarms go missing overnight, this is usually why.
